tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on the GPIO
tables.text_helper: Table 39, "Effect of low-power modes on the GPIO", in section 8.4 (GPIO in low-power modes) on page 187. Columns: Mode, Description. 4 data row(s).

rows: No effect. GPIO (EXTI) interrupts cause the device to exit Sleep mode.
No effect. GPIO (EXTI) interrupts cause the device to exit Stop mode.

The GPIO digital interface is powered down and must be reinitialized after 
exiting Standby mode. Wake-up pins can be configured to cause the device to 
exit Standby mode.
GPIO’s are set to analog mode by hardware. Pull-up or pull-down device can 
individually be enabled through the PWR_PUCRx and PWR_PDCRx registers, 
respectively, to keep the I/Os at defined levels.

The GPIO digital interface is powered down and must be reinitialized after 
exiting Shutdown mode. Wake-up pins can be configured to cause the device to 
exit Shutdown mode.
The GPIO’s are set to analog mode by hardware. Pull-up or pull-down device 
can individually be enabled through the PWR_PUCRx and PWR_PDCRx 
registers, respectively, to keep the I/Os at defined levels.
